# users.dcc.uchile.cl

> Academic resource hub hosting authoritative textbooks on information retrieval, data structures, and string algorithms by leading computer scientists.

This site hosts faculty pages and digital resources from the Department of Computer Science at the University of Chile, featuring prominent researchers and their published works in core areas of computer science.

## Key Topics

- Information Retrieval
- Compact Data Structures
- Pattern Matching
- String Algorithms
- Data Compression
- Search Technology
- Algorithm Design
- Space Efficiency
- Gonzalo Navarro
- Ricardo Baeza-Yates
- Cambridge University Press
- Textbooks
- Academic Resources
- Computer Science

## Core Textbooks

- [Modern Information Retrieval - Home](https://users.dcc.uchile.cl/~rbaeza/mir2ed/): Homepage for Modern Information Retrieval textbook by Baeza-Yates and Ribeiro-Neto, a foundational resource for search technology and IR concepts
- [Compact Data Structures](https://users.dcc.uchile.cl/~gnavarro/CDSbook/): Compact Data Structures textbook by Navarro and Munro, Cambridge University Press, covering space-efficient data structure design and implementation
- [Flexible Pattern Matching in Strings](https://users.dcc.uchile.cl/~gnavarro/FPMbook/): Flexible Pattern Matching textbook by Navarro and Raffinot, Cambridge University Press, addressing advanced string matching algorithms
